story_title: Warp's Big Bet on Building Open Source with GPT-5.5
caption:
Warp is betting big on OpenAI models like GPT-5.5 to coordinate AI coding agents across local, cloud, and open-source development workflows.

Instead of simple inline autocompletions, developer tools are shifting toward multi-agent platforms capable of managing multi-step development pipelines.

What are your thoughts on agentic developer tools? Let us know below.

Slide 3: LOCAL. CLOUD. OPEN SOURCE.. The system utilizes OpenAI models to coordinate coding agents natively across local machines, cloud environments, and open-source repos. — shown as a numbered slide beside a large offset circle.
